newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZU ASKS TO JOIN NEW BOURSE OFFICIAL LIST.
newsitem.headline: BIRZU ASKS TO JOIN NEW BOURSE OFFICIAL LIST.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzu Dairy has applied to join the new bourse official list, the stock exchange said on Wednesday.
"Birzu Dairy submitted its written application to join the official list of the bourse on Monday," head of the listing department Saulius Malinauskas told Reuters.
He also said that the board of the bourse has to make a decision in two months but it may happen earlier.
The official list began trading on Monday with two companies and two banks.
Birzu is one of the bourse's best-known shares and has issued its paper internationally via a global depository receipt (GDR) issue, the first corporate GDR in the Baltics.
